load_diffusion_pipeline_from_pretrained: load a DiffusionPipeline from a pretrained model on the Hugging Face Hub using from_pretrained
save_diffusion_pipeline: save a DiffusionPipeline to a local directory using save_pretrained with safetensors serialization
enable_model_cpu_offload: enable model CPU offloading on a DiffusionPipeline to reduce GPU memory usage with accelerate
convert_pipeline_device_dtype: move a DiffusionPipeline to a specific device and dtype using the to method
create_pipeline_from_existing: create a new DiffusionPipeline from an existing pipeline using from_pipe to reuse components
